pregunta: In the Transformer paper, what problem motivates dividing the query-key products by the square root of the key dimension?
respuesta_esperada: For large d_k the dot products grow large in magnitude, pushing the softmax into regions with extremely small gradients; scaling by 1/sqrt(d_k) counteracts this.
criterio_exito: Recupera el fragmento de §3.2.1 (scaled dot-product attention) y la respuesta menciona softmax saturado / gradientes muy pequeños para d_k grande. Parafraseada a propósito: la pregunta no dice 'scaled', 'softmax' ni 'gradients'.

pregunta: How much faster is SBERT than a plain BERT cross-encoder at locating the closest pair of sentences in a 10k-sentence collection?
respuesta_esperada: BERT needs about 50 million inference computations (~65 hours); SBERT reduces it to about 5 seconds.

pregunta: Which technique do Kingma and Welling use so that gradients can flow through the sampling of latent variables, yielding a low-variance estimator of the objective?
respuesta_esperada: A reparameterization of the variational lower bound, which yields a lower-bound estimator (SGVB) that can be optimized with standard stochastic gradient methods.
fragmento_esperado: reparameterization of the variational lower bound
criterio_exito: Recupera el abstract o la introducción de Kingma & Welling y nombra el reparameterization trick / SGVB.

pregunta: How does what GraphRAG indexes differ from the index used by the original retrieval-augmented generation model of Lewis et al.?
respuesta_esperada: Lewis et al. index Wikipedia passages as dense vectors (DPR) and retrieve top-k passages per query; GraphRAG uses an LLM to build an entity knowledge graph from the corpus and pre-generates community summaries for groups of related entities.
criterio_exito: Recupera al menos un fragmento de alguno de los dos documentos en el top-k; la respuesta describe ambos índices (vectorial denso vs grafo de entidades + resúmenes de comunidades).

pregunta: InstructGPT and DPO both learn from human preference comparisons. Which training stage does DPO eliminate compared with InstructGPT's pipeline, and why is it possible?
respuesta_esperada: InstructGPT trains an explicit reward model and then optimizes the policy with PPO (RLHF). DPO skips the separate reward model and the RL loop: via a change of variables the reward is expressed in terms of the policy, so the policy is trained directly with a classification (binary cross-entropy) loss on preferences.
criterio_exito: Recupera fragmentos de al menos uno de los dos papers; la respuesta combina el pipeline SFT→RM→PPO de InstructGPT con la reparametrización de DPO.

pregunta: What encoder architectures do Sentence-BERT and the retriever of the RAG model use to produce their dense text representations?
respuesta_esperada: SBERT fine-tunes BERT/RoBERTa in a siamese (and triplet) network with a pooling layer to get fixed-size sentence embeddings compared by cosine similarity; RAG uses DPR, a bi-encoder with two BERT-base encoders (document and query) scored by inner product (MIPS).
criterio_exito: Recupera fragmentos de al menos uno de los dos; la respuesta nombra siamese/pooling para SBERT y bi-encoder BERT-base (DPR) para RAG.
